sources.title: Land contamination risk management
sources.facts: Sets the expected staged approach for managing risks from historic land contamination.
sources.guard: Framework use does not prove contamination, remediation need or outcome.

sources.title: LCRM: before you start
sources.facts: Explains competence, regulatory controls and initial scoping before land contamination work.
sources.guard: Pre-start guidance does not validate a site investigation or conceptual model.

sources.title: Land affected by contamination
sources.facts: Explains planning and Part 2A routes for land affected by contamination.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not prove a statutory determination or safe end use.

sources.title: Contaminated land statutory guidance
sources.facts: Sets legal tests and remediation principles for contaminated land under Part 2A.
sources.guard: Statutory criteria require regulator evidence and do not classify a candidate automatically.

sources.title: Brownfield land registers
sources.facts: Explains preparation and publication of brownfield land registers and related assessments.
sources.guard: Register inclusion does not prove contamination, permission or deliverability.

sources.title: Get voluntary remediation advice for contaminated land and groundwater
sources.facts: Explains how competent persons can request Environment Agency remediation advice.
sources.guard: Advice availability does not prove documents will be accepted or remediation completed.

sources.title: Historic Landfill Sites
sources.facts: Provides known historic landfill polygons and selected licence, date and waste attributes.
sources.guard: Dataset records are not exhaustive site investigations or current permit status.

sources.title: Land and groundwater remediation deployment form guidance
sources.facts: Explains deployment under mobile plant standard rules for contaminated soils and materials.
sources.guard: A deployment route does not prove permit coverage, suitability or successful treatment.
